name: glute ham raise with extended arms
description: A glute ham raise performed with the arms stretched out in front, making the lift harder. It strongly trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Set up on the glute ham bench with your ankles locked in and thighs supported.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid arching your lower back.
